subject: storytime
title: Mouse and Cookie words
about: A boy gives a hungry mouse a cookie, and one small favor leads to the next until the whole house is in a happy muddle. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the story, so the real book from the library is easier to read on his own.
tip: After the level, borrow the book from the library and read it together, letting him read the words he practised.

book.author: Laura Numeroff
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A chain of silly favors that starts with one cookie and circles all the way back to the start.
